Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. High level answers below:

1) Payment lane: For small pilots (under $10k total spend) Procurement is usually fine with a company card. For anything over that, Procurement will require a PO and Net30 invoicing. The decision point is the committed spend band; seems like the pilot could be in the card lane unless we expand scope.

2) Marketplace: We prefer Marketplace purchases when available — it routes through our Cloud Procurement team and reduces internal approvals. If you have a GCP marketplace SKU, that would be ideal.

3) Budget & signatory: Eleanor Park (cc’d) is our finance sponsor and budget approver for the AI/ML org. The final signatory is typically our Head of IT (Markus Velez) for vendor contracts over $25k. For pilots under 25k Eleanor can sign off and Procurement issues a PO.

4) Security: Procurement wants SOC 2 + data handling FAQ. I’ve attached our standard vendor intake form (light).

I’ll loop Procurement (procurement@lumnex.com) if we move to a PO. We aim to confirm payment lane by Friday.
